fusions.name: Heaved Clod
fusions.desc: Heaves a clod of earth that deals 15 damage to the first enemy it meets and knocks it back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Grave Dig
fusions.desc: Stamps down, dealing 30 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and ignoring their armour.

fusions.name: Dug In
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 25% for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Gravedigger
fusions.desc: Against an enemy at low health, your damage rises by 15%.
